lines: Price played 37% of snaps over his last 3 games, the same as his season rate, and he averages 9.3 carries per game.
He's scoring more lately: 9.6 PPR points per game over his last 3, up from 7.1 on the season, helped by 23.3 receiving yards per game.
SEA has a bye in Wk 11. The coach said Price will keep getting a look in the role he filled last week, with Charbonnet's health making that easier.
